reference_sql:
WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end from January 2024 to December 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) - 1 AS month_end
  FROM range(DATE '2024-02-01', DATE '2026-02-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), account_mrr AS (
  -- one row per account and month end
  SELECT a.account_id, m.month_end, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM accounts a
  CROSS JOIN month_ends m
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.event_date <= m.month_end
  GROUP BY a.account_id, m.month_end
), compared AS (
  -- one row per account and month end
  SELECT account_id, month_end, mrr,
    LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end) AS prev_mrr,
    MAX(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS best_before
  FROM account_mrr
), classified AS (
  -- one row per account and month end of 2025
  SELECT account_id, month_end, mrr, prev_mrr,
  CASE WHEN prev_mrr = 0 AND mrr > 0 AND best_before > 0 THEN 'reactivation'
         WHEN prev_mrr = 0 AND mrr > 0 THEN 'new'
         WHEN prev_mrr > 0 AND mrr = 0 THEN 'churn'
         WHEN mrr > prev_mrr THEN 'expansion'
         WHEN mrr < prev_mrr THEN 'contraction'
         ELSE 'flat' END AS movement
  FROM compared
  WHERE month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', month_end) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE movement = 'new') AS new_accounts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE movement = 'reactivation') AS reactivated_accounts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE movement = 'churn') AS churned_accounts
FROM classified
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', month_end) AS DATE)

  -- one row per account and month end
  SELECT a.account_id, m.month_end, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM accounts a
  CROSS JOIN month_ends m
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.event_date <= m.month_end
  GROUP BY a.account_id, m.month_end
), compared AS (
  -- one row per account and month end
  SELECT account_id, month_end, mrr,
    LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end) AS prev_mrr,
    MAX(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS best_before
  FROM account_mrr
), classified AS (
  -- one row per account and month end of 2025
  SELECT account_id, month_end,
    CASE WHEN prev_mrr = 0 AND mrr > 0 THEN CASE WHEN best_before > 0 THEN 'reactivation' ELSE 'new' END
         WHEN prev_mrr > 0 AND mrr = 0 THEN 'churn' END AS movement
  FROM compared
  WHERE month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', month_end) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  SUM(CASE WHEN movement = 'new' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN movement = 'reactivation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reactivated_accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN movement = 'churn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_accounts
FROM classified
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', month_end) AS DATE)

solver.query:
WITH me AS (SELECT last_day(CAST(t.d AS DATE)) AS me FROM generate_series(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS t(d)), acc AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM subscription_events),
bal AS (SELECT a.account_id, m.me, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr FROM acc a CROSS JOIN me m LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.event_date <= m.me GROUP BY a.account_id, m.me),
w AS (SELECT account_id, me, mrr, LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY me) AS prev, COALESCE(bool_or(mrr > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY me ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), false) AS earlier FROM bal)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', me) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prev = 0 AND mrr > 0 AND NOT earlier) AS new_accounts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prev = 0 AND mrr > 0 AND earlier) AS reactivated_accounts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prev > 0 AND mrr = 0) AS churned_accounts
FROM w WHERE me >= DATE '2025-01-31' GROUP BY 1
